criteria.title: 1. Situation
criteria.description: Covers enemy forces (composition, disposition, likely course of action), friendly forces (higher unit mission, adjacent units), attachments/detachments, and relevant terrain and weather.

criteria.title: 2. Mission
criteria.description: A single clear sentence stating who, what, when, where and why (the 5 Ws), using a doctrinal task verb and a stated purpose.

criteria.title: 3. Execution
criteria.description: Commander's intent, concept of operations (scheme of manoeuvre and fires), tasks to each subordinate element, and coordinating instructions (timings, control measures, rules of engagement).

criteria.title: 4. Service Support / Sustainment
criteria.description: Supply (rations, water, ammunition), transport, medical evacuation plan and casualty collection, handling of detainees.

criteria.title: 5. Command and Signal
criteria.description: Location of the commander, succession of command, frequencies/call signs, passwords or challenge-and-reply, and signals for key events.

criteria.title: Clarity and format
criteria.description: Follows the five-paragraph sequence, is concise and unambiguous, and uses consistent times and grid references.
